catalog.originalPrompt:
This is an original character from my own Korean historical fantasy strategy game. The attached portrait is an AI-generated illustration of a fictional adult man in his mid-twenties, not a real person. Create a square 1:1 image of the SAME character in his awakened form, the moment he reaches his full power.

Identity: keep the exact same face, age, ethnicity, hairstyle, facial hair, body build and color palette, so he is instantly recognizable as the same hero.

Framing: upper-body shot from just above the head to around the waist. The pose must be dynamic and asymmetric, not a frontal symmetrical bust: playing a long daegeum flute held out to the side, eyes closed, his waist-length black hair lifted by a wind that carries glowing ripples of sound. The face does not need to be centered, and one shoulder may turn away from the viewer. No open palm pushed toward the viewer.

Style: semi-realistic painterly splash art, the quality of a premium Korean MMORPG male class illustration, dramatic soft rim light, high detail. Plain very dark slate-blue studio background (#1c2129) with a stronger warm glow behind the shoulders. No scenery, landscape, buildings or sky.

Costume (the main focus): a high-fashion warrior design, dashing and heroic, neither fully covered in armor nor bare. A strong, broad-shouldered silhouette true to his build: a pale indigo silk robe layered over white hemp, blue cords and beads woven through his long hair, a slim gilt-bronze belt with jade pendants, a sword hanging at his side. Gilt-bronze ornaments, small iron lamellar plates edged in gold, comma-shaped jade (gogok) beads, silk and fur. Ancient Korean Samhan / Three Kingdoms motifs, reimagined boldly and ornately. Confident, majestic, powerful.

Expression: the same personality as the reference, but more intense and resolved, a fierce or serene inner fire in the eyes. The irises may glow faintly.

Power: an aura of light rising like heat haze, with small individual sparks and light motes drawn one by one, not a single blob. If he holds a weapon, it gleams with the same light.
